description: After a confirmation link ran out (list_email_forwarding says so), has Cloudflare email each waiting inbox a new link, as Send a new link in the domain's settings does. Only owners and admins. The answer names the inbox that gets it; tell the person.

domain.description: The domain, as list_email_forwarding lists it, such as acme.com.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: resend_email_forwarding_link
title: Send a forwarding confirmation link again
